text:
Zoe: Heads-up from reseller call — Nimbus wants a co-sell via their marketplace. Key asks: marketplace metering (per-seat vs per-call), entitlement mapping (Nimbus user -> Redwood org), SSO/SAML, marketplace billing cut, telemetry opt-in, and a compliance checklist for listing. Can someone own?
Malik: I can take entitlement and billing mapping. Quick note: marketplace sellers often require meter hooks (usage callbacks) and a way to map marketplace purchase IDs to Redwood accounts. We support external entitlement mapping via our billing webhook. Need Nimbus marketplace docs.
Priya: Security/compliance: they need SOC2 attestation, DPA, and a dataflow diagram for the listing. Also confirm we don't share model weights. Telemetry must be opt-in for marketplace installs. Ask them about whether customer data ever leaves their VPC.
Owen: Architecture POV — offer two integration modes: 1) Marketplace-managed billing + Redwood Dedicated backend per-partner (simpler for Nimbus). 2) Nimbus handles billing, calls our hosted API with an entitlement token (they manage auth). Recommend #1 for pilot.
Zoe: They also want an entitlement revocation path when a marketplace subscription expires and a way to handle trial conversions.
Malik: We can implement a webhook: POST /entitlements with {"marketplace_id","customer_id","sku","expires_at"}. On revoke we deactivate API keys. Example minimal payload: ```json
{"marketplace_id":"nimbus-123","customer_id":"cust-789","sku":"redwood-pro","expires_at":"2025-06-30T23:59:59Z"}
```
Priya: Question: Who manages KMS for marketplace SSO? If Nimbus wants to hold keys we need KMS integration docs. Also confirm if they require SCIM for user provisioning.
Owen: For pricing — propose pilot: marketplace listing with reserved 1x Dedicated node + 2M token credit bundled into sku + usage overage. Nimbus will take marketplace fee; we give them a partner discount. I'll draft two sku options.
Zoe: Any blocker around telemetry or required fields for the marketplace listing? Nimbus wants anonymous usage metrics for health; no payload capture allowed.
Priya: Telemetry pattern: marketplace installs default telemetry=false; provide an opt-in toggle in the Redwood Console with anonymized metrics (counts, latencies, error rates). We can't collect request payloads without an explicit agreement.
Malik: Action items: I will write the entitlement webhook spec and sample mapping table for Nimbus IDs -> Redwood org IDs. Owen: please draft sku/price options for marketplace listing. Priya: I'll assemble compliance checklist and ask for their SOC2 + DPA. Zoe: coordinate a 30m call with Nimbus.
deploy-bot: Meeting created: "Nimbus marketplace co-sell & entitlements sync"  Tue 9:00 AM PT. Invite sent.
Malik: Posting a short spec doc into /docs/marketplace-integration and a sample curl for webhook: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/entitlements \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <admin-key>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"marketplace_id":"nimbus-123","customer_id":"cust-789","sku":"redwood-pro","expires_at":"2025-06-30T23:59:59Z"}'
```
Owen: I'll include SKU JSON examples and two price bands (trial-friendly and enterprise).
Priya: Sending the checklist DM with required docs (SOC2 cert, DPA, dataflow diagram, IdP metadata). Please don't share externally until signed off.
Zoe: Thanks team  Nimbus asked for the entitlement webhook and sku draft before the exec call tomorrow. Let's try to have drafts in the channel by EOD.
